lines: Registration fees changed: the government amended the fee table under the Registration Act, 1908, so check the new rates before registering property or documents.
An erratum corrects the Tamil Nadu Legal Metrology (Enforcement) Rules, 2011, fixing errors in an earlier notification on weights and measures enforcement.
Temple staff rules amended: service conditions under the Hindu Religious Institutions Employees (Conditions of Service) Rules, 2020, have been changed for HR&CE employees.
The Human Resources Management Department issued a notification under the Right to Information Act, 2005; the extracted text does not show whom it appoints or discloses.
Land update: 0.15 hectares of government poramboke cart road at Mittanamallee village, Avadi taluk, Tiruvallur district, is handed to CMDA for construction.
The gazette publishes a Madras High Court judgment in Election Petition No. 36 of 2026, an election-related court decision now on record.
The ordinary gazette this week only lists individual name changes and private advertisements; no further public-scheme details were extracted.
